answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator identity is tied to locked capital rather than mere node count. An attacker attempting to forge a violet web of identities must acquire a majority of the network tokens, which acts as a cryptographic cipher locking them into a trellis of economic consequences; should they misbehave, their staked assets are slashed, ensuring the cost of identity multiplication exceeds any potential illicit gain.
